title: 全书画像层与画像确认门（Adaptive Profile Layer L0）
user_summary: 分析一本书之前，先判断它是什么书。引擎会先把全书正文数一遍（免费），再抽 11 章交给模型判读，给出五项基本判断：变现模式、情感主轴、驱动引擎、视角结构、篇幅。这些判断以草稿形式呈现给你，每一项都附带依据；你用下拉菜单确认或改正，确认之后才开始抽取。改这几项的意义在于：不同类型的小说该看的东西不同，番茄那种快餐网文要看前三章的钩子，晋江的言情要看感情线节拍，用同一把尺去量所有小说，量出来的结论对谁都不准。
technical_summary: Implements the L0 layer of 10_ADAPTIVE_PROFILE_LAYER.md (2026-08-13, an extension of the frozen 01-09 contracts, not an unfreeze). Three parts. (1) L0-A/C deterministic statistics over 100% of the text at zero cost: chapter length distribution, dialogue ratio, tail shape, vocabulary rates, and a per-name decile curve; the viewpoint axis is decided by counting because a sampled read provably gets it wrong. (2) L0-B: one provider call over 11 sampled chapters (opening 3 plus an even spread) returning the axes a count cannot reach, with paragraph-anchored evidence. (3) The draft/confirm flow: five closed-vocabulary axes, disagreements between the counted and read sides recorded rather than resolved, and the user's selection outranking every inference including the whole-book one. Profile deltas dispatch additively onto the L1 extraction and enter the prompt hash so a single-lead extraction is never reused for an ensemble book.
acceptance_criteria: the viewpoint axis measured over the whole book disagrees with the same axis measured over the opening, and the whole-book value is the one kept
a profile axis value outside the closed vocabulary is refused, not coerced or stored
a user selection overrides every inferred value and is marked as the user's
with no delta active the extraction prompt is byte-identical to the core prompt, so books that need no delta pay nothing extra
the prompt hash differs between an active and an inactive delta, so cached extraction is not reused across profiles
the confirmation screen shows the evidence behind every axis before asking the user to confirm it
verification_evidence: L0-A/C on the real 806-chapter book: whole-book share(1)=0.436 -> ensemble; opening tenth share(1)=0.612 -> single_lead. The engine keeps the counted value and records the disagreement.
L0-B against the real provider returned pov_hint=single_lead (confidence 0.7) — the wrong answer the design predicted a sample would give, and the reason that axis is owned by counting. Cost ¥0.021.
Both sides independently agreed on monetization (paid_subscription, from chapter length median 3103) and engine (mystery, vocabulary 2.67/10k vs progression 0.84).
Delta dispatch: pov_entity active for the ensemble profile, inactive for single_lead; prompt hashes differ.

Delta fill-rate gate, thresholds fixed before the run: 100% fill, 12 distinct values, top1 40.0% against a 70% ceiling, on chapters 281-320 (a window whose mixed cast was established by the free measurement). The model's viewpoint concentration 0.400 lands on the independent mention share 0.406.
known_out_of_scope: Only one profile delta is registered (pov_entity for ensemble). The other deltas in 10_ADAPTIVE_PROFILE_LAYER §9 are specified but not built; a registry entry pointing at an unexercised prompt fragment would be a promise the engine cannot keep.
The opening-analysis module (fast-food profile, chapters 1-3 at paragraph resolution) is not built.
Per-chapter analysis does not yet read the profile. §4.0 places the profile before both pipelines; wiring the single-chapter pipeline is separate work.
L0-A thresholds are provisional and want calibration on a labelled corpus before they are treated as anything but priors.

data_compatibility.notes: Additive: one new table holding the draft and confirmed profile per book. No existing table is altered. A book with no profile behaves exactly as before — the profile is optional input to the engine, not a precondition for the existing paths.
